title: Omega, Ospreay & the 2026 world-title chase
summary: Omega’s comeback leads into Ospreay’s first AEW world-title victory and a difficult first major defense against Moxley.

chapters.title: Omega wins the title again
chapters.result: Omega defeats MJF after Ospreay prevents use of the diamond ring.
chapters.context: The victory sets Omega on the path to the Wembley main event.

chapters.title: Ospreay conquers Omega
chapters.result: Ospreay defeats Omega for his first AEW World Championship.
chapters.context: Their rivalry reaches its AEW world-title payoff at Wembley.

chapters.title: Ospreay finally beats Moxley
chapters.result: Ospreay retains the world title against Moxley.
chapters.context: The champion overcomes an opponent he had not previously beaten.
